_comment: DR-0670. The OpenClaw-on-the-towers registry. Each entry is one OpenClaw role behind the three brakes (this is the AI class: budget + lock + kill all stay, per the 2026-07-29 amendment). 'enabled' is the committed greenlight; ARMED-BY-RECORD beside this file is the arm. KILL = set enabled:false here, or delete ARMED-BY-RECORD, in a PR: the openclaw-tower lane reads THIS file from main on every fire and stops what it says is off. AUTO-PAUSE: an overrun (timeout, turns, tool calls) or max_consecutive_failures failures writes a pause stamped with arm_epoch; the role stays paused until a PR raises arm_epoch -- resumption goes through the gates, never by itself. A disabled entry carries disabled_why + re_review (DR-0075).

roles.name: chat-ops-report
roles.description: Role (b), report-only chat-ops pilot (STEP 4 s4.4). Reads the lane state the witness hands it -- the same open-PR / hold / main-CI data the OpsBoard reads -- and writes a short plain report. It cannot send, post, write, exec or browse: report.json denies every tool group and the gate allows only reads for role 'report'. Fired by the openclaw-tower lane on its six-hourly clock; the runner on the tower enforces the brakes.

roles.name: family-agent-eval
roles.description: Role (a), family/community action agent -- EVALUATE (STEP 4 s4.5). The long-running Gateway on the tower, loopback-only, gate plugin loaded: bright lines denied, every send/post/write asks a human first, anything unknown denied. NO chat channel is paired: pairing a family channel is a new family-facing identity and needs a bot token only Darrell holds, so it waits on his word (DR-0111 carve-out 1). Until then it is reachable only from the tower itself. max_runs_per_day 0: the lane fires no scripted turns for this role; it runs only when a person talks to it.
